sentences.text: No: the documents do not state that a 2% pre-payment charge in this Rs 80 lakh MSE sanction letter is a violation for a Tier 3 UCB, because the no-charge rule for a Tier 3 UCB applies to business purpose loans to Micro and Small Enterprises with sanctioned amount / limit up to ₹50 lakh, and this case is above that amount.

For cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB, and for term loans the charge, if levied, shall be based on the amount being prepaid.

The applicability or otherwise of pre-payment charges shall be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and where KFS is to be provided the same shall also be mentioned in the KFS.
